properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The codebase's core quantum-vulnerable asset: secp256k1 elliptic-curve ECDSA. Vendored libsecp256k1 (src/secp256k1) plus the node's entire EC call surface — key generation and signing (src/key.cpp), signature verification (src/pubkey.cpp, script interpreter OP_CHECKSIG), BIP32 child-key derivation (secp256k1_ec_seckey_tweak_add, key.cpp:239), and the recovery module enabled in the app build (configure.ac:1274 --enable-module-recovery, used by signmessage). properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 asset: AES128Encrypt/Decrypt and AES128-CBC classes in src/crypto/aes.cpp over the shared ctaes constant-time core, plus unit tests. No production consumer in the node — the only app use of AES is the wallet crypter, which uses AES-256-CBC. This is shipped library surface: reachable by any future code, and the AES-128 tables ship in the binary.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256 asset in Dogecoin Core: implementation classes in src/crypto/aes.cpp (AES256Encrypt/Decrypt/CBC modes) built on the constant-time ctaes core (src/crypto/ctaes), unit-test vectors, and the single production consumer — wallet master-key/private-key encryption in src/wallet/crypter.cpp:85/104 (AES-256-CBC, key from the iterated-SHA-512 passphrase KDF, 25000 rounds default). Symmetric — quantum impact is only Grover's halving (128-bit effective), no migration required; the real posture issue
